description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I (Reks)] to the user, grants [XII Resonance +3% Boost] to all FF12 allies

description.name: Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I (Reks)
description.text: Lightning abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Lightning abilities trigger 2 additional times, grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies in the character's row after using Lightning attacks

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Lightning Mode II (Reks)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Lightning Mode II (Reks)
description.text: Lightning abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Lightning abilities, casts Dual Dalmascan Mind after using Lightning abilities

description.name: Dual Dalmascan Mind
description.text: Causes [Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Prismatic 20% (15s)] if 0-3/4+ FF12 allies are alive, grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +15% (8s)] to all allies if 4+ FF12 allies are alive

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 10% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 10% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 10% (15s)], [Imperil Water 10% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 10% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 10% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 10% (15s)]

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 20% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 20% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 20% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 20% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 20% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 20% (15s)], [Imperil Water 20% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 20% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 20% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 20% (15s)]

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: XII Resonance +3% Boost
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 3% if the character's Realm is XII
